- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

h- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

### WhatsApp abandoned-checkout recovery (native Shopify Checkout)

`services/checkout-recovery/whatsapp-checkout-recovery.ts`, run by the
15-minute checkout-recovery cron. Reads Shopify abandoned checkouts whose phone
was verified by the OTP gate (`megaska_verified_phone`) and sends **at most two
messages per checkout**: the first once it has been idle 15 minutes (so 15–30
minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

r- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

a- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

15-minute checkout-recovery cron. Reads Shopify abandoned checkouts whose phone
was verified by the OTP gate (`megaska_verified_phone`) and sends **at most two
messages per checkout**: the first once it has been idle 15 minutes (so 15–30
minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

e- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

### WhatsApp abandoned-checkout recovery (native Shopify Checkout)

`services/checkout-recovery/whatsapp-checkout-recovery.ts`, run by the
15-minute checkout-recovery cron. Reads Shopify abandoned checkouts whose phone
was verified by the OTP gate (`megaska_verified_phone`) and sends **at most two
messages per checkout**: the first once it has been idle 15 minutes (so 15–30
minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

I- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed

### WhatsApp abandoned-checkout recovery (native Shopify Checkout)

`services/checkout-recovery/whatsapp-checkout-recovery.ts`, run by the
15-minute checkout-recovery cron. Reads Shopify abandoned checkouts whose phone
was verified by the OTP gate (`megaska_verified_phone`) and sends **at most two
messages per checkout**: the first once it has been idle 15 minutes (so 15–30
minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

T- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

o- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

15-minute checkout-recovery cron. Reads Shopify abandoned checkouts whose phone
was verified by the OTP gate (`megaska_verified_phone`) and sends **at most two
messages per checkout**: the first once it has been idle 15 minutes (so 15–30
minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

A- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

a- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

### WhatsApp abandoned-checkout recovery (native Shopify Checkout)

`services/checkout-recovery/whatsapp-checkout-recovery.ts`, run by the
15-minute checkout-recovery cron. Reads Shopify abandoned checkouts whose phone
was verified by the OTP gate (`megaska_verified_phone`) and sends **at most two
messages per checkout**: the first once it has been idle 15 minutes (so 15–30
minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

,- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

n- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

### WhatsApp abandoned-checkout recovery (native Shopify Checkout)

`services/checkout-recovery/whatsapp-checkout-recovery.ts`, run by the
15-minute checkout-recovery cron. Reads Shopify abandoned checkouts whose phone
was verified by the OTP gate (`megaska_verified_phone`) and sends **at most two
messages per checkout**: the first once it has been idle 15 minutes (so 15–30
minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

r- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

c- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

15-minute checkout-recovery cron. Reads Shopify abandoned checkouts whose phone
was verified by the OTP gate (`megaska_verified_phone`) and sends **at most two
messages per checkout**: the first once it has been idle 15 minutes (so 15–30
minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

d- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as

STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

### WhatsApp abandoned-checkout recovery (native Shopify Checkout)

`services/checkout-recovery/whatsapp-checkout-recovery.ts`, run by the
15-minute checkout-recovery cron. Reads Shopify abandoned checkouts whose phone
was verified by the OTP gate (`megaska_verified_phone`) and sends **at most two
messages per checkout**: the first once it has been idle 15 minutes (so 15–30
minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

d- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is

### WhatsApp abandoned-checkout recovery (native Shopify Checkout)

`services/checkout-recovery/whatsapp-checkout-recovery.ts`, run by the
15-minute checkout-recovery cron. Reads Shopify abandoned checkouts whose phone
was verified by the OTP gate (`megaska_verified_phone`) and sends **at most two
messages per checkout**: the first once it has been idle 15 minutes (so 15–30
minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

o- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

a- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

15-minute checkout-recovery cron. Reads Shopify abandoned checkouts whose phone
was verified by the OTP gate (`megaska_verified_phone`) and sends **at most two
messages per checkout**: the first once it has been idle 15 minutes (so 15–30
minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

 - `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

t- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

### WhatsApp abandoned-checkout recovery (native Shopify Checkout)

`services/checkout-recovery/whatsapp-checkout-recovery.ts`, run by the
15-minute checkout-recovery cron. Reads Shopify abandoned checkouts whose phone
was verified by the OTP gate (`megaska_verified_phone`) and sends **at most two
messages per checkout**: the first once it has been idle 15 minutes (so 15–30
minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

o- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

o- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

### WhatsApp abandoned-checkout recovery (native Shopify Checkout)

`services/checkout-recovery/whatsapp-checkout-recovery.ts`, run by the
15-minute checkout-recovery cron. Reads Shopify abandoned checkouts whose phone
was verified by the OTP gate (`megaska_verified_phone`) and sends **at most two
messages per checkout**: the first once it has been idle 15 minutes (so 15–30
minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

r- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

}- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

15-minute checkout-recovery cron. Reads Shopify abandoned checkouts whose phone
was verified by the OTP gate (`megaska_verified_phone`) and sends **at most two
messages per checkout**: the first once it has been idle 15 minutes (so 15–30
minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

 - `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

### WhatsApp abandoned-checkout recovery (native Shopify Checkout)

`services/checkout-recovery/whatsapp-checkout-recovery.ts`, run by the
15-minute checkout-recovery cron. Reads Shopify abandoned checkouts whose phone
was verified by the OTP gate (`megaska_verified_phone`) and sends **at most two
messages per checkout**: the first once it has been idle 15 minutes (so 15–30
minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

 - `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

### WhatsApp abandoned-checkout recovery (native Shopify Checkout)

`services/checkout-recovery/whatsapp-checkout-recovery.ts`, run by the
15-minute checkout-recovery cron. Reads Shopify abandoned checkouts whose phone
was verified by the OTP gate (`megaska_verified_phone`) and sends **at most two
messages per checkout**: the first once it has been idle 15 minutes (so 15–30
minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

r- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

P- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

15-minute checkout-recovery cron. Reads Shopify abandoned checkouts whose phone
was verified by the OTP gate (`megaska_verified_phone`) and sends **at most two
messages per checkout**: the first once it has been idle 15 minutes (so 15–30
minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

s- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

i- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

### WhatsApp abandoned-checkout recovery (native Shopify Checkout)

`services/checkout-recovery/whatsapp-checkout-recovery.ts`, run by the
15-minute checkout-recovery cron. Reads Shopify abandoned checkouts whose phone
was verified by the OTP gate (`megaska_verified_phone`) and sends **at most two
messages per checkout**: the first once it has been idle 15 minutes (so 15–30
minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

 - `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)

`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as

### WhatsApp abandoned-checkout recovery (native Shopify Checkout)

`services/checkout-recovery/whatsapp-checkout-recovery.ts`, run by the
15-minute checkout-recovery cron. Reads Shopify abandoned checkouts whose phone
was verified by the OTP gate (`megaska_verified_phone`) and sends **at most two
messages per checkout**: the first once it has been idle 15 minutes (so 15–30
minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

t- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

A- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

15-minute checkout-recovery cron. Reads Shopify abandoned checkouts whose phone
was verified by the OTP gate (`megaska_verified_phone`) and sends **at most two
messages per checkout**: the first once it has been idle 15 minutes (so 15–30
minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

n- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)

`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

 - `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

### WhatsApp abandoned-checkout recovery (native Shopify Checkout)

`services/checkout-recovery/whatsapp-checkout-recovery.ts`, run by the
15-minute checkout-recovery cron. Reads Shopify abandoned checkouts whose phone
was verified by the OTP gate (`megaska_verified_phone`) and sends **at most two
messages per checkout**: the first once it has been idle 15 minutes (so 15–30
minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

 - `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

 - `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

### WhatsApp abandoned-checkout recovery (native Shopify Checkout)

`services/checkout-recovery/whatsapp-checkout-recovery.ts`, run by the
15-minute checkout-recovery cron. Reads Shopify abandoned checkouts whose phone
was verified by the OTP gate (`megaska_verified_phone`) and sends **at most two
messages per checkout**: the first once it has been idle 15 minutes (so 15–30
minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

A- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

.- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

15-minute checkout-recovery cron. Reads Shopify abandoned checkouts whose phone
was verified by the OTP gate (`megaska_verified_phone`) and sends **at most two
messages per checkout**: the first once it has been idle 15 minutes (so 15–30
minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

c- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

f- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

### WhatsApp abandoned-checkout recovery (native Shopify Checkout)

`services/checkout-recovery/whatsapp-checkout-recovery.ts`, run by the
15-minute checkout-recovery cron. Reads Shopify abandoned checkouts whose phone
was verified by the OTP gate (`megaska_verified_phone`) and sends **at most two
messages per checkout**: the first once it has been idle 15 minutes (so 15–30
minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

 - `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)

`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as

keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

### WhatsApp abandoned-checkout recovery (native Shopify Checkout)

`services/checkout-recovery/whatsapp-checkout-recovery.ts`, run by the
15-minute checkout-recovery cron. Reads Shopify abandoned checkouts whose phone
was verified by the OTP gate (`megaska_verified_phone`) and sends **at most two
messages per checkout**: the first once it has been idle 15 minutes (so 15–30
minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

u- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

15-minute checkout-recovery cron. Reads Shopify abandoned checkouts whose phone
was verified by the OTP gate (`megaska_verified_phone`) and sends **at most two
messages per checkout**: the first once it has been idle 15 minutes (so 15–30
minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

e- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

r- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

### WhatsApp abandoned-checkout recovery (native Shopify Checkout)

`services/checkout-recovery/whatsapp-checkout-recovery.ts`, run by the
15-minute checkout-recovery cron. Reads Shopify abandoned checkouts whose phone
was verified by the OTP gate (`megaska_verified_phone`) and sends **at most two
messages per checkout**: the first once it has been idle 15 minutes (so 15–30
minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

n- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

 - `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

### WhatsApp abandoned-checkout recovery (native Shopify Checkout)

`services/checkout-recovery/whatsapp-checkout-recovery.ts`, run by the
15-minute checkout-recovery cron. Reads Shopify abandoned checkouts whose phone
was verified by the OTP gate (`megaska_verified_phone`) and sends **at most two
messages per checkout**: the first once it has been idle 15 minutes (so 15–30
minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

5- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

y- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

15-minute checkout-recovery cron. Reads Shopify abandoned checkouts whose phone
was verified by the OTP gate (`megaska_verified_phone`) and sends **at most two
messages per checkout**: the first once it has been idle 15 minutes (so 15–30
minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

l- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is

 - `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

### WhatsApp abandoned-checkout recovery (native Shopify Checkout)

`services/checkout-recovery/whatsapp-checkout-recovery.ts`, run by the
15-minute checkout-recovery cron. Reads Shopify abandoned checkouts whose phone
was verified by the OTP gate (`megaska_verified_phone`) and sends **at most two
messages per checkout**: the first once it has been idle 15 minutes (so 15–30
minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

 - `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is

### WhatsApp abandoned-checkout recovery (native Shopify Checkout)

`services/checkout-recovery/whatsapp-checkout-recovery.ts`, run by the
15-minute checkout-recovery cron. Reads Shopify abandoned checkouts whose phone
was verified by the OTP gate (`megaska_verified_phone`) and sends **at most two
messages per checkout**: the first once it has been idle 15 minutes (so 15–30
minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

s- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

r- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

15-minute checkout-recovery cron. Reads Shopify abandoned checkouts whose phone
was verified by the OTP gate (`megaska_verified_phone`) and sends **at most two
messages per checkout**: the first once it has been idle 15 minutes (so 15–30
minutes after the shopper left; skipped if it cannot go out within 6 hours) and
a reminder 24 hours after the first if they still have not ordered (dropped if
it cannot go out within 30 hours). A phone gets at most two recovery messages in
any 7 days. Opted-out numbers are skipped.

- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — must be `true`
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_SHOPS` — comma-separated myshopify domains
- `CHECKOUT_RECOVERY_SIGNING_SECRET` — 32+ chars (shared with the COD email)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_FIRST` (default `checkout_recovery`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_REMINDER` (default `checkout_recovery_reminder`)
- `WHATSAPP_RECOVERY_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE` (default `en`)

Both templates need one URL button
`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

L- `WHATSAPP_INTENT_RECOVERY_ENABLED` — legacy recovery for LoopD2C express-checkout
  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

Webhook: `https://<app-host>/api/webhooks/whatsapp` (subscribe the `messages`
field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as
STOP / "Stop promotions" record an opt-out (AuditEvent `whatsapp.opt_out`,
keyed by phone) that recovery sends respect; START opts back in. Failed
delivery statuses are logged.

`https://<store-domain>/apps/loopd2c/checkout/bag?t={{1}}`; only the token is
sent. The link rebuilds the bag and opens the drawer with Pay online and COD.

  intents (in-drawer checkout modal); off unless `true`.

field). Verification uses `WHATSAPP_META_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`. Replies such as

delivery statuses are logged.
